1. Fatigue and weakness
2. Muscle cramps, spasms, or twitching
3. Tingling or numbness in the hands, feet, and around the mouth

5. Pain in the face, aches and pains in the muscles
6. Depression or anxiety
7. Headaches
8. Difficulty concentrating
9. Dry, coarse skin and brittle nails
10. Hair loss
11. Muscle cramps or spasms, including painful muscle contractions (tetany)
12. Chapped lips
13. An irregular heart rhythm (arrhythmia)
